My dog of nine years is no longer with me. Severe tartar damaged his oral tissues and left him in constant distress. We proceeded with anesthetic dental cleaning, hoping to heal his painful mouth. He laid in my lap and accepted pets the morning we left for the vet. I wish there was a safer way to help you. No more throbbing tooth pain. Rest happily, my dearest friend.
